note: The two sets are effectively identical: same 19 claims, same values and quotes, differing only in that A labels the HSS4X4X1/4 claim 'member' and B labels it 'structural member'. Both bind values loosely (generic 'dimension'/'component' entities, no section or grid context), and both repeat W10X15 under two names. Neither set misreads a value or invents a figure, so neither is preferable.
remarks: Both extractions treat every dimension as 'dimension | length' with no reference to which member, span or detail it belongs to (e.g. 3'-7", 5'-3", 8" are the small dimensions near C5/S-511 in Section 1), which loses most of the engineering meaning. W10X15 is stated twice (once as 'component | specification', once as 'First Floor Framing | member section'). Section labels (STRUCTURAL SECTION 1 / 4) and grid lines present on the page would be useful binding context and are absent from both sets.
